title: Larry Flynt asks Christic Institute to investigate Jessica Savitch's death, with G. Gordon Liddy

tellings.quote: look uh I want to retain you at this chis The christic Institute that you guys have uh we'd like to retain you to uh investigate uh the death of uh of uh Savage

plain: In the 1980s, at the Park Hotel in Washington DC, the magazine publisher Larry Flynt is said to have asked an organisation called the Christic Institute to look into the death of the television news anchor Jessica Savitch, saying, "we'd like to retain you to investigate the death of" Savitch. The story is told by a lawyer named Dan Sheehan, who says he was in the room as part of the Institute, and he links the meeting to G. Gordon Liddy, a former White House operative, and to a man named William J. Davis. If it happened as he tells it, a powerful publisher privately suspected there was more to Savitch's death than was known.
